_comment: M14.0.SPEC (#419) — html completeness classification, 2026-10-22. Every public NAMED node type of the pinned wasm/tree-sitter-html.wasm (19 distinct; the grammar exposes 26 named slots over 41 ids) is classified as handled_verified (read by the analyzer) or internal_silent (correctly emits nothing), with `entity` decided by an explicit design decision rather than by a bucket. The COVERAGE block below is the 14-VALUE cell: the ten canonical types plus `decorates`, `renders`, `mixes_in` and `part_of`.

handled_verified.note: Fourteen types, each read in src/ast/real-html-analyzer.ts and each pinned. `document` supplies the module symbol's range and the DOCTYPE; `element`/`start_tag`/`self_closing_tag`/`tag_name` supply the DOM hierarchy and the address space; `attribute`/`attribute_name`/`attribute_value`/`quoted_attribute_value` supply the attributes, the IDREF class and the resource carriers; `script_element`/`style_element`/`raw_text` supply the EMBEDDED-SCRIPT SEAM; `ERROR` is the broken-node boundary the analyzer bypasses by contract. The measured node-type inventory is validation/m14/measurements/html-grammar-nodes.json (26 named slots / 41 ids, 19 distinct named types, served digest 11b3405c1543).

internal_silent.note: Five types that correctly emit nothing and need no analyzer read. `end_tag` needs none because the element's PUBLISHED range already covers its children; `erroneous_end_tag` and `erroneous_end_tag_name` are the broken-markup boundary, which the analyzer bypasses by contract (the `ERROR` row); `comment` and `text` are LITERALS — a comment is not a symbol and a text run is not a symbol, and the whole point of reading the tree instead of scanning the source is that a directive inside a text run cannot masquerade as one. THIS ROW IS ALSO THE REASON `part_of` IS RULED AND NOT IMPLEMENTED: the construct's bytes arrive as `text`.

gap.note: No node type is left unread-and-undecided. The 14-VALUE cell's gaps live in the COVERAGE block's arithmetic, not here: this block is about NODE TYPES, and the coverage block is about RELATIONSHIP TYPES.

decisions.question: Should the analyzer decode character references by reading `entity` child nodes, or by decoding the attribute's own text? RULED: decode the TEXT, in pure-String. An `entity` is a child of `quoted_attribute_value`'s value span, so reading it would make the decoded value a per-fragment assembly rather than one string per attribute — and the analyzer's whole contract for an attribute is one decoded string (the value of `href="?a=1&b=2"` is one module name, not three fragments). It also keeps the ordering that matters for security: the decode runs BEFORE scheme detection, so `javascript:` and `javascript:` are recognised as `javascript:` rather than smuggled past a filter — measured on the scheme-and-navigation fixture, where the pre-fix bare `startsWith("javascript:")` missed both. An unknown or malformed reference is copied through VERBATIM, because dropping half a URL invents a different resource; the `odd-ref`, `no-semi` and `prose-amp` pins carry that half of the contract.

excluded.label: part_of
excluded.from: RULED UNDECIDABLE — THE LADDER WAS WALKED AND THE NAMED RUNGS WERE UNAVAILABLE. THE CONSTRUCT: `part_of` names a PART — a file that shares its compilation unit's single scope, imports nothing, and cannot be resolved as a separate module (src/ast/types.ts). R1 UNAVAILABLE: the html lane's grammar is a MARKUP grammar — the SERVED build declares 26 named slots over 41 ids and 19 DISTINCT named node types (validation/m14/measurements/html-grammar-nodes.json, served digest 11b3405c1543), and 0 of them is a part/include/declaration construct; the same holds for the three delegate grammars the seam uses (javascript and typescript have each published their own measured `part_of` rulings on exactly this ground, and css is a stylesheet language with no unit inclusion). R2 UNAVAILABLE FOR A CORRECT IMPLEMENTATION, AND THIS IS THE MEASURED REASON: the construct's real spelling DOES occur in the admitted set — the bare line-initial `include <path>` form, 379 sites over 127 files (script/m14/html-extended-construct-probe.ts's own census, 8,888 admitted files) — but THE SPELLING IS NOT THE SEMANTICS: a PUG `include` is a textual, scope-sharing include (a part), while the SAME bare line in an .html file (the bulma docs' `_includes/` tree) is a static-site-generator partial rendered with the caller's context (an import, with its own scope) — 120 of the 379 sites are in .html files, 252 in .pug. A tree-sitter grammar is given BYTES AND NOTHING ELSE and cannot see a file's DIALECT, so a patched html grammar would have to assign ONE meaning to a construct whose meaning is a property of the dialect; the only available discriminator is the file extension, which is a ROUTING fact and not a property of the construct. R3 UNAVAILABLE: the construct's bytes arrive in the tree as `text`, which THIS SPEC classifies as a literal (see internal_silent), the analyzer's own header states the file is 'pure tree-sitter AST extraction ... fully regex-free' (src/ast/real-html-analyzer.ts:2-4), and the lane's own HTML-IDENTITY rule states that 'Template elements/attributes/directives are NEVER symbols' (src/ast/real-html-analyzer.ts:61-64) — there is NO NODE for the construct, and manufacturing one by scanning text would be a text extraction rather than an AST read. THE NEAR MISS, NAMED AND COUNTED: the template-language include/extends/partial family — 1,920 directives over 618 files of the admitted population (validation/m14/measurements/html-extended-constructs-2026-10-22.txt), in disjoint buckets: `{% include %}` 1,265, pug `include` 320, `{% extends %}` 251, pug `extends` 64, handlebars-style `{{> partial}}` 11, `{% import %}` 5, `{% from %}` 3, `<link rel="import">` 1; and the bare form, 379 sites over 127 files (.pug 252 over 64 files, .html 120 over 57 files, .erb 6 over 5 files, .xhtml 1 over 1 file). THE FALSIFIER NAMES A COUNTED CONSTRUCT: a `part_of` row published by the html analyzer over the admitted population — the construct counter is the census's own `part directives` count — 0 in 0 files over 13,768 embedded blocks in 4,644 files of the admitted population (validation/m14/measurements/html-extended-constructs-2026-10-22.txt) — and the 320 pug `include` sites the census counts; the RUN falsifier is the html arm's own `part_of` row over the whole admitted population, which reads 0; RUN FALSIFIER: the html arm over the whole admitted population, where a non-zero `part_of` row falsifies this ruling. THE DISCLOSURE THE RULING OBLIGES: the admitted population carries 2,070 template-dialect files (23% of it) whose template constructs NO FLEET LANE MODELS, and the html analyzer's markup reading of those files is partly bypassed — on spectre/docs/src/elements/forms.pug it publishes 14 symbols and 20 relationships and reports a parse ERROR spanning lines 232-725 of 725. That is a FLEET COVERAGE GAP, reported to the Lead, and this cell does not absorb it.

corpusUnexercised.from: THE CORPUS DOES NOT EXERCISE THE CONSTRUCT, AND THE ANALYZER DOES PUBLISH IT. 0 mixin clauses in 0 files — and, more strongly, 0 `class_heritage` clauses in 0 files, so the whole admitted population has NO class heritage at all to be a mixin in (validation/m14/measurements/html-extended-constructs-2026-10-22.txt) — and the arm's `mixes_in` row is 0 edges over the whole population (validation/m14/measurements/html-arm-closure-2026-10-22.json). denominator.note: n = 13, not 14: `part_of` is RULED UNDECIDABLE on a counted, cited near miss with a falsifier that names a counted construct, and a ruling class LEAVES the denominator. The gate recomputes applicable as 14 − 1 = 13 and checks this number against its own.

coverage._from: THIRTEEN OF FOURTEEN IMPLEMENTED, ONE RULED UNDECIDABLE — AND THE SHAPE OF THIS LANE IS THAT ITS OWN GRAMMAR IS A MARKUP GRAMMAR WHILE ITS ANALYZER IS A CONTAINER: src/ast/real-html-analyzer.ts merges the relationships of an embedded-script delegate (JS/TS/CSS) via mergeEmbeddedBlocks (src/ast/real-html-analyzer.ts:2003), reading the engine's context (engine.ts:1323 extractHtmlEmbeddedBlocks → engine.ts:1895-1908) and copying each delegate row VERBATIM with metadata.htmlEmbedded=true and metadata.embeddedLang. THE PRODUCTION PATH IS MANDATORY AND THAT IS MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED: the same draw through a bare Analyzer.analyze reads calls 0 — it cannot see the delegate, because the delegate's trees arrive through the engine context — while ASTEngine.parseFile reads the full count. THE POPULATION IS MEASURED AND RECONCILED: 8,888 admitted files = the GIT-TRACKED set (git ls-files), the router's own thirteen admitted spellings (incoming-gate.ts:319), under the engine's 1 MB cap, over 96 repositories, from 202 corpus entries every one of which is a symlink; 182 symlinked directories followed, 147,104 directories visited, 2 files over the cap (largest 2,619,858 bytes), 2 tracked-but-absent, 0 bare-basename admissions. The lane's own census (script/m14/html-population.ts) and the GATE's own admission rule (incoming-gate.ts:447) were run independently and returned the same number and the same per-extension table (.html 6,786 · .hbs 1,531 · .twig 274 · .j2 139 · .pug 70 · .erb 49 · .xhtml 30 · .htm 3 · .liquid 3 · .jinja 3 = 8,888; .mustache, .ejs and .njk are admitted and absent). THE RESOLUTION CLOSURE IS MEASURED OVER THAT WHOLE POPULATION, IN FIVE DISJOINT SLICES of the same sorted admitted list the gate itself sorts (incoming-gate.ts:532), and the closure adds up EXACTLY: validation/m14/measurements/html-arm-closure-2026-10-22.json. THE FIVE OPEN TYPES WERE MEASURED TWO WAYS: a whole-population CONSTRUCT CENSUS (0 decorator nodes, 0 implements clauses, 0 jsx elements, 0 mixin clauses, 0 part directives, and 0 class_heritage clauses, over 13,768 embedded blocks in 4,644 files) and a PLANTED-DOCUMENT SEAM PROBE through ASTEngine.parseFile, which publishes decorates, implements, renders and mixes_in and DROPS part_of. THE FIXTURE PINS ALL FOUR BY NAME, DIRECTION AND meta.embeddedLang AND FORBIDS part_of, AND ITS FOUR CONTROLS FIRED (each construct removed in turn fails its own pin and no other). THE TEMPLATE DIALECTS ARE A FLEET GAP AND ARE DISCLOSED, NOT ABSORBED: 2,070 admitted files (23% of the population) carry 1,920 template directives over 618 files that no lane in the fleet models.

_implemented_measured._unit: edges published through the PRODUCTION path (ASTEngine.parseFile, which builds the inline <script>/<style> context) over the WHOLE admitted population — 8,888 git-tracked files, the router's own thirteen admitted spellings, under the engine's 1 MB cap, 96 repositories, 182 symlinked directories followed. The measurement is the incoming-gate's own TABLE 1 (PER PROJECT — production's resolution scope), taken in FIVE DISJOINT SLICES of the same sorted admitted list the gate itself sorts and merged by script/m14/html-arm-merge.ts; the per-chunk outputs are validation/m14/measurements/html-arm/chunk-{0,2000,4000,6000,8000}.txt and the merged closure is validation/m14/measurements/html-arm-closure-2026-10-22.json. THE RESOLVED COUNT IS A LOWER BOUND: a repository longer than one slice STRADDLES a slice boundary, and a straddling repository's per-project key space is split, which can only move edges OUT of `resolved`.
